evidence.observation: Pressure 2.952 Torr at growth start, matching the ~2.96 Torr plateau seen through the ramp at 100 sccm
Pressure rose steadily to 3.159 Torr (about +0.04 Torr every 120 s) over 5 events
Argon flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the argon supply does not explain the pressure rise
Temperature holding at 750 °C with heater power ~44%, which looks normal
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed, so air getting in through a leak cannot be told apart from a blocked exhaust

args.missing_evidence: No reference [mean, sd] values were given, and there is no exhaust O2 sensor. To tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage: close the inlet and check whether pressure keeps rising (a rate-of-rise leak test), or check the exhaust and pump line for a restriction.
